name: paper-to-research-video
description: Turn a research paper and its available evidence into a source-faithful, approximately 90-second research video.

interface.longDescription: Create a source-grounded 80–100 second research video from an academic paper and available figures or recordings. Build a claim ledger, shot list, animated scenes, captions, and an MP4. Recorded footage must be supplied or captured; explanatory scenes are labeled. Local rendering tools and scientific review are required.
defaultPrompt: Turn this paper into a polished 90-second research video with verified claims, captions, and an MP4.
Make a silent, captioned conference demo film from this paper and its figures.

publication.release_notes: Initial skill release with evidence checks and a Remotion production starter.
